name: Advanced National Accounts & Supply-Use Tables (SUT) Masterclass
description: Intensive 5-day residential programme on advanced SNA 2008 compilation, constructing Supply and Use Tables (SUT), double deflation, and reconciling informal sector estimates.
learningOutcomes: Construct balanced Supply and Use Tables (SUT) for 140 product and industry groups
Implement double deflation using producer price and trade indices
Model Financial Intermediation Services Indirectly Measured (FISIM) across institutional sectors

name: Executive Workshop on Index Numbers Revision (CPI, IIP & WPI)
description: High-level technical workshop on base year revisions, modernizing price collection, hedonic quality adjustment, and chain-base index methodologies.

competencies.name: Index Numbers & Price Statistics (CPI, IIP, WPI)

learningOutcomes: Execute base-year revision workflows for CPI and IIP
Formulate weighting diagrams from Household Consumer Expenditure Survey microdata
Implement international hedonic pricing standards for high-tech commodities

tpacMetadata.courseDirector: Deputy Director General, Price Statistics Division

name: Advanced Multi-Stage Sampling & Weight Calibration in NSS Rounds
description: Rigorous residential programme on probability sampling, master frame development, small area estimation, and survey weight calibration using auxiliary data.
learningOutcomes: Design complex multi-stage sampling plans optimizing survey precision vs operational cost
Implement Generalized Regression (GREG) and Small Area Estimation (SAE) models
Calibrate multi-stage survey weights using administrative register totals

name: Intensive Residential Bootcamp: Reproducible Analytical Pipelines (RAP) in R & Python
description: Hands-on coding bootcamp at NSSTA computing labs covering modern R package development, Polars high-performance data processing, version control with Git, and automated report pipelines.

competencies.name: Statistical Computing with R for Official Statistics
Python for Data Engineering & Official Statistical Analytics

learningOutcomes: Architect end-to-end reproducible analytical pipelines for official survey publications
Develop and document internal R packages conforming to NSO coding standards
Automate statistical bulletin generation with parameterized Quarto templates

tpacMetadata.courseDirector: Director, DIID & Technical Training Head, NSSTA

name: Automated Microdata Scrutiny, Fellegi-Holt Validation & Imputation Workshop
description: Specialized training on statistical data editing, logical consistency matrices, Fellegi-Holt methodology, and modern multivariate imputation techniques.

competencies.name: Statistical Computing with R for Official Statistics

learningOutcomes: Formulate mathematical error localization rules minimizing data modification
Implement donor hot-deck and predictive mean matching for missing values
Evaluate post-imputation bias and variance distortion

tpacMetadata.courseDirector: Deputy Director General, Data Processing Division

name: Microdata Anonymization & Statistical Disclosure Control (SDC) with sdcMicro
description: Hands-on lab course on protecting respondent confidentiality: measuring re-identification risk, implementing k-anonymity, l-diversity, perturbation, and releasing open microdata safely under the DPDP Act.

competencies.name: Statistical Computing with R for Official Statistics

learningOutcomes: Calculate global and individual re-identification disclosure risks using sdcMicro
Apply recoding, micro-aggregation, and local suppression to achieve k-anonymity (k>=5)
Audit microdata releases for compliance with DPDP Act and national data governance standards

name: Executive Leadership & Evidence-Based Policy Advisory for Senior Official Statisticians
description: Senior leadership programme on translating statistical intelligence into high-impact policy briefs for Cabinet Secretariat, NITI Aayog, and PMO, handling high-stakes media conferences, and safeguarding statistical integrity.

competencies.name: Statistical Data Storytelling, Visualization & Public Dissemination

learningOutcomes: Draft concise policy advisories summarizing complex socio-economic survey findings
Lead transparent official press conferences and handle adversarial media scrutiny
Uphold scientific objectivity and institutional independence under external pressures
